rules.title: Replace starter data
rules.summary: Replace neutral starter data with source-backed architecture, release, and project rules before treating Architext as current.
rules.rationale: Fresh installs validate immediately, but starter data is not project-specific documentation.

rules.title: Refresh README screenshots on UI change
rules.summary: Any UI-facing change that affects layout, chrome, controls, or visible editor behavior must run go run ./tools/screenshots and refresh the checked-in README screenshots.
rules.rationale: The README is the public visual contract for the current macOS app surface, so screenshots must not drift behind implemented UI.
